claims: The 2025 Samsung S90F is a 4K QD-OLED smart TV.
The 2025 Samsung S90F features the NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor.
The 2025 Samsung S90F has peak brightness exceeding 1400 nits.
The 2025 Samsung S90F supports 4K@144Hz.
The 2025 Samsung S90F has four HDMI 2.1 ports.
The 2025 Samsung S90F runs on Tizen OS.
The 2025 Samsung S90F is available in 55-77 inch sizes.
The 2025 Samsung S90F lacks Dolby Vision support.
The 65-inch version of the 2025 Samsung S90F utilizes a QD-OLED panel.
The 65-inch version of the 2025 Samsung S90F provides 99.9% DCI-P3 color accuracy.
The 65-inch version of the 2025 Samsung S90F has no white sub-pixels.
The 2025 Samsung S90F delivers over 1400 nits peak brightness (10% window).
The NQ4 AI Gen3 processor uses 128 neural networks for 4K AI Upscaling Pro.
The 2025 Samsung S90F features Motion Xcelerator 144Hz.
The 2025 Samsung S90F supports FreeSync Premium Pro.
The 2025 Samsung S90F supports VRR.
The 2025 Samsung S90F has access to Samsung TV Plus.
The 2025 Samsung S90F has built-in voice assistants Alexa and Bixby.
The 2025 Samsung S90F features a LaserSlim design.
The 2025 Samsung S90F supports Dolby Atmos.
The 2025 Samsung S90F supports Q-Symphony.
The 2025 Samsung S90F relies on HDR10+.
The 2025 Samsung S90F is available for purchase.
